content.name: Gabriel Montoya
content.title: Special Education Paraprofessional
content.summary: Paraprofessional in a K–3 resource and self-contained special education program, with an Associate in Arts in Elementary Education and a passing ParaPro Assessment score. Bilingual in English and Spanish and trained in de-escalation, I support 8 students with IEPs daily and plan to complete my bachelor's and teacher certification.

experience.title: Before- and After-School Program Aide (part-time)
bullets: Supervised groups of 20–25 K–5 students for homework help, snacks and outdoor games while studying full-time.
Led a weekly reading circle for 12 English learners using bilingual picture books.
Kept daily sign-in and sign-out logs with zero safety incidents across the school year.

experience.title: Special Education Paraprofessional
bullets: Support 8 students with IEPs in a K–3 self-contained classroom, delivering small-group reading and math lessons planned by the special education teacher.
Collect daily behavior and IEP goal data on tablets, giving the teacher accurate progress-monitoring data for 3 annual IEP meetings a month.
Use visual schedules and first-then boards that helped one student cut classroom exits from 6 a day to 1.
Translate parent notes and phone calls into Spanish for 5 families, improving homework folder return from about half to nearly all.
